ISER directory describes Cherry Gulch Therapeutic Boarding School in Emmett, ID 83617, serving boys with learning differences and emotional and behavioral problems, consistent with OUSD's Special Education Department contract
research.notes: Website and contact details intentionally omitted: the school appears to have closed (CA directory: closed 2025-05-24; other sources give conflicting closure dates) and cherrygulch.org currently serves a misconfigured server certificate and no readable page. Third-party directories (ISER) list PO Box 678, Emmett, ID 83617, 208-365-3437, info@cherrygulch.org, but these were not confirmed on an official page. Not found in ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer (likely for-profit; D&B lists 'Cherry Gulch, Inc.' but page was blocked), so legal name, EIN and entity numbers left null.

profile.summary: Cherry Gulch was a ranch-style therapeutic boarding school in Emmett, Idaho, for boys who were about 10 to 14 years old when they enrolled. It offered schooling along with weekly therapy for students with learning differences and emotional or behavioral challenges. California was certified to place students there as an out-of-state nonpublic school. California's school directory lists it as closed as of May 24, 2025.
